extracted.intended_audience: researchers and practitioners conducting scoping reviews and decision-framework development for biomass-to-hydrogen pathways (energy/chemical engineers, bioresource researchers, and journal reviewers/editors)
extracted.subtask_description: A preregistered PRISMA-ScR protocol for a feedstock-matched scoping review that systematically maps compatibility between biomass feedstock classes and conversion pathway families and produces decision-support outputs (suitability matrix, TRL assessment, decision tree).

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to PRISMA-ScR reporting guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: This review is conducted in accordance with PRISMA for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) reporting guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow PRISMA-ScR checklist for reporting scoping reviews; protocol registration is documented prior to database search commencement to increase transparency and reduce bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feedstock-anchored review organisation
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide structured, feedstock-anchored guidance for pathway selection rather than organising reviews solely by technology family or performance metric.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organise results and synthesis around feedstock-driven compatibility logic to support feedstock-matched decision-making (explicitly contrast with technology- or metric-centric organisation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive coverage of feedstock classes and pathway families
rubrics_metrics.description: Systematically map the compatibility of seven biomass feedstock classes with nine conversion pathway families — spanning thermochemical, hydrothermal, catalytic reforming, biological, photobiological, bioelectrochemical, electrochemical (biomass-assisted), and photocatalytic routes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the review includes all seven feedstock classes and all nine pathway families claimed; transparently list which feedstock classes and pathway families are included and any exclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary research question — feedstock characteristics determining suitability
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify what feedstock characteristics determine the suitability of thermochemical, hydrothermal, biological and bioelectrochemical biomass-to-hydrogen conversion routes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extract and synthesise feedstock properties (e.g., composition, moisture, ash, particle size, contaminants) and map how these characteristics influence pathway compatibility and performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secondary research question — TRL, costs, carbon intensity, and scale-up barriers
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess technology readiness levels (TRL), indicative production costs, carbon intensities, and scale-up barriers for each pathway family.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each pathway family, report TRL (with system-boundary qualification), provide indicative production cost estimates, quantify carbon intensity where possible, and list documented scale-up or commercialization barriers; be explicit about assumptions and boundaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tertiary research question — decision logic for pathway selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop decision logic that can guide researchers and practitioners in selecting an appropriate conversion pathway for a given biomass feedstock profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Synthesize findings into operational decision rules or a decision tree that is usable for early-stage screening; make negative-selection criteria explicit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search strategy and sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Five-family Boolean search strings will be run across Web of Science (Core Collection), Scopus, ScienceDirect, and supplementary grey literature sources (IEA Bioenergy Task 33, NREL/DOE, IRENA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use documented Boolean strings covering the five families; include major bibliographic databases and targeted grey literature sources to capture technical reports and policy documents; report full search strings and dates run.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search date range
rubrics_metrics.description: Date range for searches: January 2015 – April 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly state and justify the date range used; report any updates or re-runs of searches and capture publication/capture dates accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-stage screening procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Two-stage screening consisting of title/abstract screening followed by full-text screening.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement and report the two-stage screening workflow, inclusion/exclusion criteria at each stage, and any screening reliability checks (e.g., number of reviewers, conflict resolution).

rubrics_metrics.name: Data extraction across specified fields (16 fields)
rubrics_metrics.description: Data will be extracted across 16 fields including feedstock characterisation, pathway family, scale, TRL (with system-boundary qualification), evidence strength, H₂ yield, production cost, and carbon intensity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the full list of extraction fields; use standardized formats/units where possible; document extraction protocols, calibration between extractors, and handling of missing or heterogeneous data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology readiness level (TRL) with system-boundary qualification
rubrics_metrics.description: Extract and report TRL for systems, with explicit qualification of the system boundary used for the TRL assessment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When assigning TRLs, state the system boundary (e.g., lab-scale reactor vs integrated system), justify ratings, and document sources/evidence supporting TRL assignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence strength assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess and record the strength of evidence supporting findings for each pathway/feedstock pairing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use transparent criteria for evidence strength (e.g., experimental scale, replication, modeling assumptions, peer-reviewed vs grey literature); report uncertainties and confidence levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: H₂ yield extraction
rubrics_metrics.description: Extract reported H₂ yields for pathways and feedstocks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record units and basis (e.g., yield per kg feedstock, per MJ, molar yields), measurement conditions, and any normalization or assumptions applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicative production cost extraction
rubrics_metrics.description: Extract indicative production costs for pathways where reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document cost metrics, currency and year, cost components included, assumptions about scale and sensitivity, and provide comparability notes across studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carbon intensity extraction
rubrics_metrics.description: Extract carbon intensity metrics for pathways (e.g., CO₂e per unit H₂) and report system boundaries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify system boundaries and lifecycle stages included (e.g., cradle-to-gate, cradle-to-grave), reporting units, and assumptions for allocations or co-products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feedstock-to-pathway suitability matrix with explicit negative-selection logic
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce a feedstock-to-pathway suitability matrix that includes explicit negative-selection logic (i.e., criteria that rule out specific pathways for particular feedstocks).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make negative-selection rules explicit and evidence-based; indicate levels of suitability (e.g., suitable, conditional, unsuitable) and link to extracted feedstock characteristics and evidence strength.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology readiness assessment across pathway families (planned output)
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver a technology readiness assessment across all nine pathway families as a planned output of the review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Synthesize TRL findings across studies into comparative assessments, noting heterogeneity, dominant evidence sources, and research gaps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision tree for early-stage pathway screening (planned output)
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a decision tree to support early-stage pathway screening for selecting conversion pathways based on feedstock profiles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design the decision tree to be practically usable for early-stage screening, document logic, thresholds used, and illustrative examples; validate against case studies if possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protocol preregistration and transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Protocol registered prior to database search commencement (OSF registration DOI provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preregister methods and analysis plans to improve transparency and reduce selective reporting; provide registration DOI and dates in the review report.
